summary:
Phase P2C (Production Briefing on Work Orders for cloned products) — backend 69/69 GREEN (incl. new TestP2CBriefing 8 tests). Frontend e2e via Playwright/Chromium 1920x1080 verified end-to-end: cloned RFL-AOD-H11-V1 -> RFL-AOD-H11-V9 (Trial -> Approved Released), edited recipe via PUT (removed GND-OUT, qty +5 + catatan_proses='P2C diff note' on first cable DEV-OUT-S). Created WO as redi (WO-20260628-003) — backend auto-attached briefing with: compared_to_sku='RFL-AOD-H11-V1', summary_text='Catatan Produk: Produk ini berbeda dari RFL-AOD-H11-V1. Perubahan utama: 1 kabel dihapus, 1 kabel berubah, 1 bundle berubah.', important_changes=['Kabel BERUBAH: DEV-OUT-S (qty_per_pcs, catatan_proses)','Kabel DIHAPUS: GND-OUT','Bundle BERUBAH: H'], removed_recipe_codes=['GND-OUT'], changed_recipe_codes=['DEV-OUT-S','GND-OUT'], changed_bundle_codes=['H'].

UI verification results (PASS unless flagged):
 - WorkOrderDetail /work-orders/WO-20260628-003: briefing-card PRESENT, summary-text starts 'Catatan Produk: Produk ini berbeda dari RFL-AOD-H11-V1...' PASS, 3 briefing-change items PASS, briefing-compare-btn PRESENT linking to /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V9/compare/RFL-AOD-H11-V1 (click navigates correctly) PASS.
 - Bundles tab on WorkOrderDetail: bundle H card has 'Berubah' badge PASS.
 - CUTTING SHEET ROWS on WorkOrderDetail: NO 'changed-badge-*' rendered on DEV-OUT-S row (or any row) — FAIL (review item explicitly requires changed-badge-changed on changed cables).
 - BundleDetail /work-orders/WO-20260628-003/bundles/H: briefing-compact PASS (text 'Catatan Produk: Produk ini berbeda dari RFL-AOD-H11-V1...'). No row badge inside H — expected because the changed cable in H is GND-OUT which was REMOVED and therefore not present in the bundle's cables list.
 - BundleDetail /work-orders/WO-20260628-003/bundles/A: briefing-compact PASS; DEV-OUT-S row shows 'Berubah' badge (changed-badge-changed) PASS.
 - /work-orders/WO-20260628-003/print/cutting-sheet: briefing-card PRESENT at top PASS. BUT no changed-badge on individual cutting rows — FAIL (consistent with WorkOrderDetail row bug).
 - /work-orders/WO-20260628-003/print/bundle-labels: 'BERUBAH vs RFL-AOD-H11-V1' chip on changed bundle (H) PRESENT PASS.
 - Negative case WO for V1 (WO-20260628-002): briefing-card NOT rendered PASS (backend confirmed briefing=null in WO response).
 - Regression: Admin sees clone-product-btn on V1 PASS; WO list loads PASS; Compare page reachable from briefing-compare-btn PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: CuttingRow component does NOT receive or render the briefing/ChangedBadge. The parent passes `briefing={wo.briefing}` at line 156 but the function signature at line 256 destructures only `{ row, onSet, canEdit }`. As a result, changed cables (e.g. DEV-OUT-S) on the cutting sheet tab show NO 'Berubah'/'Dihapus' badge — review item explicitly requires data-testid='changed-badge-changed' or 'changed-badge-removed' on changed rows.
Print cutting-sheet renders the briefing-card at top but does NOT render changed-badge-* on individual cable rows. Same root cause as above — no cableChangeKind/ChangedBadge usage on rows.

action_items: Fix WorkOrderDetail.jsx CuttingRow: add `briefing` to props, compute `const ck = cableChangeKind(briefing, row.cable_code)`, and render `{ck && <ChangedBadge kind={ck} />}` next to the cable_code cell. Note: 'removed' cables are not in `rows` so only 'changed' will surface there; if reviewer wants 'Dihapus' rows to also appear, the cutting sheet endpoint must include a removed-only row list — out of scope for a small UI fix.
Fix print/CuttingSheetPrint.jsx similarly — pass briefing to row rendering and add ChangedBadge.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: WorkOrderDetail.jsx line 156 passes `briefing={wo.briefing}` to <CuttingRow .../> but the function defined on line 256 ignores it. The ChangedBadge import on line 24 is therefore unused on the cutting tab. Must be wired up to satisfy review.
BUG: print/CuttingSheetPrint.jsx — only briefing-card at top, no per-row ChangedBadge.

GOOD: BundleDetail.jsx correctly uses cableChangeKind + ChangedBadge on each cable row inside the bundle (line 89) and renders briefing-compact + extra 'Bundle ini berbeda...' notice when bundleChangeKind returns 'changed'.
GOOD: WorkOrderDetail.jsx bundles tab correctly renders ChangedBadge on bundle headers via bundleChangeKind (line 171/179).
GOOD: print/BundleLabelsPrint.jsx renders 'BERUBAH vs <src>' chip on changed bundle labels via bundleChangeKind (line 31).

GOOD: Backend POST /api/work-orders auto-builds briefing via _build_briefing only when product has parent_sku/source_sku; for plain V1 WO, briefing=null and ProductionBriefing returns null (early return on line 18 of ProductionBriefing.jsx). Negative case verified.

GOOD: routes.py briefing snapshot is denormalized into the WO doc (generated_at, summary_text, important_changes, added/removed/changed codes, changed_bundle_codes) so subsequent product edits do not retroactively alter past WO briefings — correct snapshot semantics for production handoff.

Minor: ProductionBriefing.jsx compact branch strips 'Catatan Produk: ' from summary_text via .replace then re-adds 'Catatan Produk: ' prefix — works but fragile if summary_text format ever changes (currently summary always starts with that prefix in backend). OK.

Minor: cableChangeKind returns the FIRST matching kind (added/removed/changed). In our test, GND-OUT was BOTH in removed_recipe_codes AND changed_recipe_codes — the function returns 'removed' first. This is benign (consistent with intent) but backend should ideally not list the same cable in both arrays.

success_rate.frontend: 85% — 6 of 7 P2C review items GREEN; cutting-sheet row badges (WorkOrderDetail + CuttingSheetPrint) are NOT rendered

seed_data_creation: Test created RFL-AOD-H11-V9 (clone of V1 with GND-OUT removed + first-cable qty/catatan changed), WO-20260628-001/002/003 plus stale WO-20260627-001/002 from prior session. All test data was deleted after the run (V9 + cascade subcollections, all WOs and qc_results/batch_colors), and V1 was reset to status='Released' with parent/source/version_group unset. DB confirmed clean: products=['RFL-AOD-H11-V1'], work_orders=[].
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2C briefing END-TO-END working at backend + most UI surfaces. Two frontend gaps remain: (1) WorkOrderDetail.jsx CuttingRow line 256 must accept `briefing` and render ChangedBadge via cableChangeKind(briefing, row.cable_code); (2) print/CuttingSheetPrint.jsx needs the same fix. ProductionBriefing.jsx + ChangedBadge are already in place — the helpers cableChangeKind/bundleChangeKind work and were verified on BundleDetail (bundle A DEV-OUT-S row shows 'Berubah') and Bundles tab (bundle H). Reproduction recipe: clone V1->V9 (Trial), approve V9 to Released, GET /api/products/V9/recipe, PUT modified list (remove GND-OUT, bump qty on DEV-OUT-S + add catatan_proses), POST /api/work-orders {product_sku:V9,...}. Briefing payload examples are in this report's summary. WO-detail compare-btn href = /products/<sku>/compare/<source> and Compare page loads under all 3 roles (verified in iteration_5).
rca_of_the_issue: RCA — Cutting sheet row badges missing on WorkOrderDetail and CuttingSheetPrint: ProductionBriefing.jsx exports ChangedBadge + cableChangeKind helpers and they ARE imported in WorkOrderDetail.jsx (line 24), but the inner `CuttingRow` component (defined locally in the same file, lines 256-294) destructures only { row, onSet, canEdit } from its props — the `briefing` prop passed by the parent at line 156 is silently dropped. As a result, no per-row ChangedBadge is rendered on the cutting sheet tab. Same omission in print/CuttingSheetPrint.jsx (imports ProductionBriefing card but does not call cableChangeKind on each row). Mitigation (one-line per file): (a) WorkOrderDetail.jsx: change `function CuttingRow({ row, onSet, canEdit })` to `function CuttingRow({ row, onSet, canEdit, briefing })` and inside the first TableCell render `const ck = cableChangeKind(briefing, row.cable_code); ... {ck && <ChangedBadge kind={ck} />}`. (b) Apply identical change in CuttingSheetPrint.jsx row mapping. After fix, expected DOM under WO-20260628-003: `[data-testid='cs-row-DEV-OUT-S'] [data-testid='changed-badge-changed']` count>=1.
